main.content:
==English==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:der|xno:asetz<ety:from<fro:asez>>|tree=1}}
From {{der|en|xno|asetz}}, from {{der|en|fro|assez||enough}}. Originally singular, with the meaning "enough to meet liabilities"; later [[reanalyze]]d as a plural form.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈæsɛts/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-assets.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{head|en|noun form}}

# {{plural of|en|asset}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|p|sg=asset}}

# {{lb|en|finance}} Any [[property]] or [[object]] of [[value]] that one [[possess]]es, usually considered as applicable to the [[payment]] of one's [[debt]]s.
#: {{ux|en|His '''assets''' are much greater than his liabilities.}}
# {{lb|en|accounting}} The left side of a [[balance sheet]].
#: {{ux|en|The '''assets''' must equal liabilities, otherwise there is an error in your balance sheet.}}
# {{lb|en|legal}} {{cap|sufficient}} [[estate]]; property sufficient in the hands of an [[executor]] or [[heir]] to pay the [[debt]]s or [[legacy|legacies]] of the [[testator]] or [[ancestor]] to satisfy [[claim]]s against it.
# Any [[goods]] or property properly available for the [[payment]] of a [[bankrupt]]'s or a [[deceased]] person's [[obligation]]s or [[debt]]s.
# {{lb|en|slang|vulgar|usually|in the plural}} {{cap|private parts}}; a woman's [[breasts]] or [[buttocks]], or a man's [[genitalia]].
